notes: Encoded ONLY from Guardian's own page. No York/Coleman/Luxaire content imported, even though the page lists York-family sister brands. SHIPPED year-only: month is the 3rd character, a letter, and its chart is image-only (see report image-pass). COUNTING (coordinator attention): the page distinguishes '3rd character' for month from '2nd & 4th numerical digits' for year, and its description enumerates letter digits vs numerical digits separately, so the year counts among numerical digits only: 2nd numerical digit '7' (normalized index 3) + 4th numerical digit '8' (normalized index 5) -> '78' -> 1978, encoded as split positions [[3,4],[5,6]]. Alternative character-position reading (chars 2 and 4 -> '0','7' -> 2007) is documented here but NOT shipped, because it contradicts the page's own numerical-digit wording; the literal reading yields a valid year, so no falsification forces reinterpretation.

styles.era: 10-character serials, letter + digit + letter + 7 digits, year only
styles.notes: Year = 2nd & 4th numerical digits combined: numerical digits in order are 0,7,9,8,2,7,0,0, so 2nd='7' and 4th='8' -> '78' -> 1978. Split positions [[3,4],[5,6]] in the normalized serial. Month = 3rd character letter 'F', chart-only, so year-only.
